title: Garbage Truck Route & Pickup Tracker
problem: Villagers dump household trash near open drains because nobody knows which day the Panchayat sanitation tractor visits our street.
idea: A weekly pickup board. Tap the day and it tells you which streets the Panchayat tractor visits and what waste to keep ready. A quiz teaches wet and dry waste sorting.

widgets.heading: 📅 Try it: Which day is it today?
widgets.intro: This is a sample schedule. In my real project, the Panchayat gives the actual days and times.
widgets.question: Today is…

options.label: Monday
options.result: Tractor comes to Main Road and School Street at 7 am. Keep wet and dry waste ready.
options.te: సోమవారం ఉదయం 7కి మెయిన్ రోడ్, స్కూల్ వీధికి ట్రాక్టర్ వస్తుంది.

options.label: Wednesday
options.result: Tractor comes to Temple Street and Colony at 7 am.
options.te: బుధవారం ఉదయం 7కి గుడి వీధి, కాలనీకి ట్రాక్టర్ వస్తుంది.

options.label: Friday
options.result: Tractor comes to Main Road and Market area at 7 am.
options.te: శుక్రవారం ఉదయం 7కి మెయిన్ రోడ్, మార్కెట్ దగ్గరకి వస్తుంది.

options.label: Other days
options.result: No pickup today. Keep waste covered at home. Don't throw it in drains!
options.te: ఈరోజు చెత్త సేకరణ లేదు. ఇంట్లో మూత పెట్టి ఉంచండి. కాలువలో వేయకండి!

questions.why: Food and peels are wet waste. They can become compost.

questions.q: A plastic milk packet goes in…
questions.why: Plastic is dry waste. Rinse it and keep it dry.

questions.q: Why not throw trash in open drains?
options: It blocks water and breeds mosquitoes
questions.why: Blocked drains cause flooding, smell and diseases like dengue.
Paper is dry waste and can be recycled.

how: Ask the Panchayat Secretary or tractor driver for the real pickup days, times and streets.
Open Canva and make a weekly chart: days on top, street names below, with tractor icons.
Add green and blue bin pictures showing wet and dry waste.
In Scratch, make 7 day buttons. When a day is clicked, the sprite says which streets get pickup.
Add a sound alert like 'Tractor is coming!' using Text to Speech.
Print the chart for the Panchayat notice board and share a photo in the village WhatsApp group.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Make a simple weekly garbage pickup chart for my village with these days and streets: [paste schedule]. Also write 4 short lines in simple Telugu and English telling people to separate wet and dry waste and never throw trash into drains.
